verdict.rationale: GA4's Data API documents a batch method, batchRunPivotReports, that returns multiple pivot reports in one call. BigQuery export lets users pull all raw events in bulk. Both are read/export operations, though; the Admin API is documented only for automating individual setting reads and changes, with no batch mutation. Missing for 10: documented bulk create/update/delete across many config items (e.g., batch custom dimensions or key events), bulk operations through the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
